Name: More Rabbits - void white blue colors etc.
Author: asbean
Description:
[size=5][b]More Bunnies
[/b][/size]Vanilla rabbits-- in more colors! 

[b]Color options:[/b]
[list]
[*]Vanilla
[*]White (matches vanilla wool color & comes in albino variation)
[*]Black (matches void chickens & comes in non-demonic variation)
[*]Brown (matches brown chickens)
[*]Blue (matches blue chickens)
[*]Extra White
[*]Taupe
[*]Light Pink
[/list]
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
1. Make sure you have [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures mod[/url] installed
2. Download the zip file
3. Unzip and copy to the "Mods" folder 
4. Restart your game if you have it running.

[size=5][b]Usa[/b][/size][size=5][b]ge[/b][/size]
1. Buy special scissors from Robin's shop (500g)
2. Click on the bunny you want to style with the scissors.
3. Pick the style you want:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/fdgkx3JF/preview-new.png[/img]
